scope: Complete parsed current E3 calibration report with declared leading-root aliases only; bounded saved-output audit and lead reconciliation completed, consumer/service/native qualification separate.
limits: All parsed report keys, types and values are preserved except the 141 declared leading-root replacements. Original raw bytes remain unchanged locally. This wrapper cannot recreate the original bytes or substitute for a raw-report gate.

The independent saved-output audit and lead reconciliation accept three finite calibration cases only. Exact external audit identities are included as metadata; their complete source/runtime/artifact ledgers are not duplicated in this portable report.

Whole output hashes were first established by the post-close audit and then matched by the lead. They are not original encode-time full hashes. Returned/persisted report equality was an executed helper gate, not a comparison of two independently retained whole report objects.

Raw PCM streams, full output probe JSON and complete source/output frame streams are not retained. PCM equality is supported by runtime collector receipts, not an independent byte recompare or fresh re-decode. Geometry acceptance relies on the executed validator and retained child receipts, not a new probe.
All three target encodes retain 499-byte stderr streams. Warning-bearing success does not establish harmlessness, performance, visual quality or general player behavior.

Runtime binaries, source fixtures, output media, raw stderr and other artifact payloads are excluded. Existing report references and recorded evidence remain intact. Neither this report nor a source-only restore recreates private runtime authority.
Actual 42 owned children closed with no live child. Resource point checks and abort requests are not a disk quota, guaranteed exit or whole-OS census.

Telemetry counts are not video pixel identity. FLAC identity is representation-specific s16le stereo. No service publication, native UI, Windows, default/catalog activation or audio-policy qualification follows. The separate consumer binding is source-reviewed and integrated at the owning cutoff; actual real-service/native proof remains pending.
